verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a free developer tier (up to 4 vCPU / 8 GB RAM) with no credit card required. A self-serve flow goes from signup to first query in about five minutes, including creating a cluster, loading data and querying, so no sales call is needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the free-tier signup, and documentation of any free-tier duration or storage limits.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can evaluate with a free tier or trial — real queries on real data without a credit card or a sales call

citations.quote: Free developer tier. Spin up a dev instance to kick the tires. Up to 4 vCPU... No credit card required
From signup to your first query in about five minutes: create a cluster, connect any ClickHouse client, load data, and query.
